items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: That's Newman's daddy, see? Dwight Newman.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's Lloyd Warnock, too. That's Newman's daddy, see? Dwight Newman. That's Martin, and that's Charlie, see? Mm-hmm.
That's a... He looks awful young, this, this Henry Martin. Looks awful young there, doesn't he?
What is his name? Henry. And that's Warnick? That's Warnick, yeah.
And this? That's Joe Newman, he's playing with bass in our bass. That's his daddy, Dwight Newman. And the drummer?
